note: This file is the only thing a weekly change edits. Then run: node scripts/build.mjs (it writes made/index.html and the made line on the one page).
Entries are newest first. Put the new week at the top.
date: the Wednesday the line went out, like 18 nov. Never a week number.

label: the area in plain words, then ' · new' or ' · better' (it just works and heads down are always better). Areas: profiles, finding people, chats, nightlife, play, your choices, it just works, heads down.
headline: the story's big sentence, lowercase, no full stop. It says what a member can do now. Never how it works, never what is coming, never a number about people or money.
note: optional. Only what every app has, or what the site already says in public. Leave it out when unsure.
shipped: how many things were merged that week.
areas: five numbers that add up to shipped, in this order: people, chats, going out, play, under the hood.
kind: 'nobar' is an entry before the build began (no shipped, no areas, no bar). 'backstory' is the one grey entry at the end; its words about the four projects are written in scripts/build.mjs.
